title: English Practice Quiz 0860
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: Customer Service: A customer has waited for an hour. What is the best response?
options: I apologise for the wait. I will check the status for you.
questions.explanation: Acknowledge the delay and offer a practical next step.

questions.question: Customer Service: What does professionalism include?
questions.explanation: Professional conduct involves respectful and dependable behaviour.

questions.question: Customer Service: What does a service standard describe?
Customer Service: You do not know an answer. What should you say?
options: I will check the correct information for you.
questions.explanation: It is honest and offers to find accurate information.

questions.question: Customer Service: How can customer feedback help?
questions.explanation: Feedback reveals strengths and improvement opportunities.

questions.question: Customer Service: What does courtesy mean?
Customer Service: A customer asks for a supervisor. What should you do?
Customer Service: Which behaviour builds trust?
questions.explanation: Trust grows through accuracy and reliability.

questions.question: Customer Service: When should a service request be closed?
options: When the action is completed and recorded

questions.question: Customer Service: What makes an apology professional?
questions.explanation: A sincere apology acknowledges the issue directly.
